name: stl-plugin
description: STLFLIX development process for collaborators: global CLAUDE.md, MCP connections (GitHub, Vercel, Firecrawl), process skills (spec-driven, atomic commits, green gate, handoff, security) and the product-ops design system.

firecrawl_api_key.title: Firecrawl API key
firecrawl_api_key.description: Key from https://www.firecrawl.dev/app/api-keys. Powers the firecrawl MCP (search + scrape). Stored in the Keychain.

buildloop_ops_token.title: BuildLoop ops MCP token
buildloop_ops_token.description: Bearer token issued by the BuildLoop panel on the platform. Scopes the buildloop MCP to your own database on the ops Postgres cluster. Stored in the Keychain.
